entries.source:
You temporarily set aside a part of you mind to direct your telekinetically-wielded bow. It will automatically attack the nearest target each turn for %d turns.
			The telekinetically-wielded bow uses Willpower in place of Strength and Cunning in place of Dexterity to determine attack and damage.
			You are not telekinetically wielding anything right now.
entries.target:
你暂时分出一部分精神来控制念动之弓。它会在 %d 回合内每回合自动攻击一个随机目标。
			念动弓以意志代替力量、以灵巧代替敏捷，来决定命中和伤害。
			你暂时还没有装备任何念动武器。

		At level 5 casting Aether Avatar removes up to %d magical or physical detrimental effects.

entries.source:
Dear Rolf,

I hope this letter finds you well. I must apologise for this recent dry spell in our communication; my adventures across Maj'Eyal have taken many exciting and perilous turns as of late. What turns do I speak of, you ask? I know how you delight in reading the accounts of my exploits, so I shall waste no further time on this pre-amble.

Imagine, if you will, a wolf. Imagine a beastly wolf, a wolf with strength, ferocity and a lust for flesh matching that of an entire pack of its lesser kind. You too may have some small experience with these "wargs" as the locals are wont to call them. Now... imagine one the size of a bear. Truly, as I travelled the lands surrounding Derth did I come across such a monstrous, awe-inspiring, lupine adversary. With fangs of a length to match my own blade, I entered combat against this lupine lord and its skulking brood. To my regret I failed in slaying the beast, but I assure you - simply surviving against such feral rage is an honour worthy of recognition and renown.

And indeed, would there have been much glory in killing such a creature? True, I would have had enough to fur to line each and every boot and hat in Derth, but legends must live on. They are what give this world its very spirit!

With eager anticipation for your reply,
Weisman
entries.target:
亲爱的罗尔夫，

希望你收到这封信时一切安好。近来我们有一阵子没有通信，我必须为此道歉；最近，我在马基·埃亚尔各地的冒险经历了许多既刺激又危险的转折。你问我指的是什么转折？我知道你喜欢阅读我的冒险事迹，所以就不再把时间浪费在这些开场白上了。

请想象一匹狼。再想象一匹凶猛的狼，它的力量、凶性和对血肉的渴望，足以匹敌一整群较弱的同类。你或许也多少见识过一些当地人惯称为“座狼”的野兽。现在……再想象其中一匹有熊那么大。确实，我在德斯周边旅行时就遇到了这样一个可怕、惊人的狼族强敌。它的獠牙长如我的剑刃，我于是与这匹座狼之王及其潜伏的狼群展开战斗。遗憾的是，我没能杀死这头野兽；但我向你保证，能在如此狂野的暴怒下生还，本身便是值得赞誉、足以扬名的荣耀。

而且，杀死这样的生物又能有多少荣耀呢？没错，我本可以得到足够多的毛皮，给德斯的每一双靴子和每一顶帽子都做上内衬，但传奇必须流传下去。正是传奇赋予了这个世界真正的精神！

热切期待你的回信，
威斯曼

entries.source: The Doomed strike from behind a veil of darkness or a host of shadows.
entries.target: 末日使者从黑暗帷幕或阴影群的掩护下发动攻击。

entries.source: Engaged in a grapple draining %d stamina per turn and redirecting %d%% of damage taken to %s.  Any movement will break the effect as will some unarmed talents.
entries.target: 处于抓取状态，每回合消耗自身 %d 点体力，并将自身所受伤害的 %d%% 转移给 %s。任何移动和某些徒手技能都会中断此效果。

entries.source: The target is in a whistling vortex, granting +%d ranged defense, -%d ranged accuracy and incoming projectiles are 30%% slower.
entries.target: 目标处于尖啸漩涡中，获得 +%d 远程闪避、-%d 远程命中，向其飞来的抛射物速度降低 30%%。

entries.source:
Each time you take damage, you roll %d%% of your mental save against it.  A successful saving throw can crit and will reduce the damage by at least 50%%.
		The first talent point invested will also increase the amount of Psi you gain from Willpower by 0.5, but reduce the amount of life you gain from Constitution by 0.25.
		The first talent point also increases your solipsism threshold by 10%% (currently %d%%).
entries.target:
每当你受到伤害时，你会用精神豁免的 %d%% 与本次伤害数值进行一次检定。检定成功时可触发精神暴击，并会使伤害至少降低 50%%。
		学习此技能时，（高于基础值 10 的）每点意志会额外增加 0.5 点灵能值上限，而（高于基础值 10 的）每点体质会减少 0.25 点生命上限（若低于基础值 10 则增加生命上限）。
		学习此技能也会使你的唯我临界点提高 10%%（当前 %d%%）。

entries.source:
Draw on the wounds of enemies within range 10, healing yourself and putting them into a merciful sleep.
							The sleep chance increases with your Spellpower.
							You are healed for %d%% of the remaining damage of bleed effects on enemies in range (minimum %d per bleed). Enemies fall asleep for %d turns longer than their longest-lasting bleed, rendering them unable to act. The strength of the sleep effect is based on the strength of the bleed. Excess damage will reduce their sleep duration.
							
							When the sleep ends, each target will benefit from Insomnia for a number of turns equal to the amount of time it was asleep (up to ten turns max), granting it 50%% sleep immunity.
entries.target:
吸收附近10码范围内敌人的伤痕以治疗自己，并仁慈地使它们入睡。
							睡眠概率受法术强度加成。
							你获得范围内敌人各流血效果剩余伤害 %d%% 的治疗（每个流血效果至少 %d 点）。敌人睡眠的持续时间为 %d 回合加上流血效果中最长的持续时间，期间无法行动。睡眠效果的强度由流血效果的强度决定，额外的伤害会缩短它们睡眠的时间。

							目标会在睡眠期间逐回合累积失眠，最多累积10回合；醒来后，失眠的剩余持续时间与睡眠抗性会逐回合衰减，每剩余1回合通常提供至多20%%睡眠抗性。

entries.source:
Your fungus reaches into the primordial ages of the world, granting you ancient instincts.
		Each time you receive non-regeneration healing you gain %0.1f%% of a turn per 100 life healed.  This effect can't add energy past 2 stored turns and overhealing is not counted.
		Also, regeneration effects on you will decrease your equilibrium by %0.1f each turn.
		The turn gain increases with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你身上的真菌可追溯至世界的原初时代，赋予你远古本能。
		每当你受到非回复类治疗时，每实际恢复 100 点生命，你获得 %0.1f%% 个回合。
		溢出治疗不计入，且这一效果提供的能量最多可储存至 2 个回合。
		同时，你身上的回复效果会使失衡值每回合减少 %0.1f。
		获得的回合数受精神强度加成。

entries.source:
You manipulate the spacetime continuum in such a way that you switch places with another creature with in a range of %d.  The targeted creature will be confused (power %d%%) for %d turns.
		The spell's hit chance will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你操纵时空连续体，与 %d 码范围内的另一个生物交换位置。目标会混乱（%d%% 强度）%d 回合。
		法术命中率受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Your battle cry shatters the will of your foes within a radius of %d, lowering their Defense by %d for 7 turns, making them easier to hit.
		All evasion and concealment bonuses are also disabled.
		The chance to hit increases with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
你的战吼会击溃前方 %d 码锥形范围内敌人的斗志，使其闪避降低 %d 点，持续 7 回合，令其更容易被命中。
		躲闪与隐匿提供的未命中加成也会被禁用。
		命中率受物理强度加成。

entries.source: Any attack that would drop you below 1 hit point instead triggers Second Life, deactivating the talent, setting your hit points to 1, then healing you for %d.
entries.target: 任何使你生命值降到 1 点以下的攻击都会激活第二生命，自动中断此技能并将你的生命值恢复到 1 点，然后受到 %d 点治疗。

entries.source:
Heighten the fears of those near to you. Any foe you attempt to inflict a fear upon and who remains in a radius of %d and in sight of you for %d (non-consecutive) turns, will take %0.2f mind and %0.2f darkness damage and gain a new fear that lasts for %d turns.
			This effect completely ignores fear resistance, but can be saved against.
entries.target:
加深你周围敌人的恐惧。所有被你灌注恐惧的目标若停留在你视野内，并且和你距离不超过 %d，这样累计达到 %d 回合时，受到 %0.2f 精神和 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并获得一个新的持续 %d 回合的恐惧效果。
			这一效果无视恐惧抗性，但可以被豁免。

entries.source: Magical runes may be inscribed onto your body, granting you an on-demand spell talent.
entries.target: 魔法符文可以铭刻在你身上，赋予你一个可按需使用的法术技能。
